tools.name: submit_urls
tools.description: Send URLs to AVS Indexer for indexing. THIS SPENDS CREDITS: 1 credit per URL for normal, 10 credits per URL for instant. Before you call this tool, call estimate_cost, tell the user how many URLs will be sent and how many credits it will cost, and wait for the user to say yes. Credits are taken when

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Work out how many credits a submission will cost and whether the balance covers it. Nothing is submitted and no credits are spent. Send the URLs (best: invalid and duplicate URLs are counted exactly) or just url_count. Call this before submit_urls and show the result to the user.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Show the AVS Indexer credit balance, the price per URL, and whether the account can use instant indexing. No credits are spent.

tools.name: list_batches
tools.description: List recent submissions (newest first) with their state, URL counts, credits, refunds and drip-feed progress. Optional project filter. No credits are spent.

tools.name: get_batch
tools.description: Show one submission by its batch_id: state, URL counts, credits used and refunded, drip-feed progress, and the URLs the URL check skipped with the reason for each. No credits are spent. States: queued, processing, dripping (waiting for the next daily share), submitted, skipped (every URL was skipped

tools.name: stop_drip
tools.description: Stop a drip-feed submission. URLs already sent stay sent. URLs not sent yet are cancelled and their credits go back to the balance. This can't be undone. Ask the user before you call it.

tools.name: check_index
tools.description: Check whether Google has indexed each URL. THIS SPENDS CREDITS: 3 credits per URL. Before you call this tool, tell the user how many URLs will be checked and the credit cost, and wait for a clear yes. Send urls, or batch_id to check the URLs of an earlier submission. tools.name: get_index_check
tools.description: Show the results of an index check by its check_id: how many URLs are indexed, not found yet, or still being checked, and (optionally) the result for each URL. No credits are spent. Results per URL: indexed, not_found (Google does not show it yet; a free recheck may be pending), checking, rechecking

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_urls, get_balance, list_batches, get_batch, check_index, get_index_check · Public sink: submit_urls, estimate_cost, get_batch, check_index.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_urls, get_balance, list_batches, get_batch, check_index, get_index_check · Public sink: submit_urls, estimate_cost, get_batch, check_index

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
